name: commit-local-changes
description: Stage and commit all pending changes in one local commit with a fixed message; no push or remotes.
content: Stages all pending changes (git add -A) in a local repo and creates exactly one commit with a fixed message on the current branch. It verifies the exact staged file set, a clean working tree, a single commit whose parent equals the pre-commit baseline, and absence of git remotes. It never pushes, never creates branches, and performs no hosting/remote operations. Inputs generalize the repo path, message, expected file set, and baseline ref; all checks are re-run on every invocation. Fails closed on configured remotes, empty or mismatched staged set, dirty tree, or parent/baseline mismatch.

repoPath.description: Absolute path of the local git repository.

commitMessage.description: Exact commit message to use for the single commit.

expectedChangedPaths.description: Optional exact set of git-style paths (e.g. docs/checklist.md) that must be staged after add -A. Fails on mismatch.

baselineRef.description: Ref resolved before committing, used to verify exactly one commit after it. Default: main.

requireNoRemotes.description: Fail if any git remote is configured. Default: true.

validationNotes: Reviewed execution records of session-8ae43c38-7960-406f-9c62-246f6b50ccf6: pre-commit status showed 2 modified (docs/checklist.md, src/message.txt) + 3 untracked (data/sample.json, notes.txt, src/new-feature.txt); git add -A staged exactly those 5 files (A/M name-status); one commit 00309da… with message 'test: update commit e2e fixture' on branch work, parent 214b141…, working tree clean, no remotes, fixture id unchanged. Program generalizes repoPath/commitMessage/expectedChangedPaths/baselineRef, re-derives all SHAs per run, and fails closed on remotes, empty/mismatched staged set, non-clean tree, subject mismatch, or parent/count mismatch. Requires git on PATH and workspace-write access to the repo. Historical success is not proof of future state; every invocation re-verifies.
